question: What prevents wishlisted products from eventually being purchased?
summary: Observed from 10 retrieved chunks across app_store, blog, forum, play_store, social: Fit / size doubt after save, No resurface when size / stock improves, Wishlist feels like a dead list, Sizing runs small. Impact ranking uses share, source diversity, and severity — not star ratings. Implications below are hypotheses for Part 3 interviews, not conclusions.

sub_themes.name: Fit / size doubt after save
paraphrased_examples: Users describe fit / size doubt after save after liking or saving a Nykaa Fashion item — enough to stall a 30-day purchase.
sub_themes.hypothesis: Fit / size doubt after save may delay 30-day wishlist conversion.
interview_probes: When you saved something recently, did fit / size doubt after save come up?

implications: Observed: liked items sit after fit/quality doubt. Hypothesis: resolving post-save uncertainty (size, fabric, colour) unblocks purchase more than a promo.
